params.body:
The test workflow ran on `ubuntu-latest`, which now resolves to Ubuntu 26.04. Playwright 1.59 cannot install Chromium's dependencies there (`Playwright does not support chromium on ubuntu26.04-x64`), so every run stopped before the first e2e test; #101 is the first PR that hit it. Build and lint passed in that run.

This pins the job to `ubuntu-24.04`, where the runs up to 10 October were green. Moving to a newer image becomes a deliberate change, made together with a Playwright that supports it.

After merge, an open PR reruns on the pinned image once it is closed and reopened (a rerun keeps the old workflow).
params.title: CI: run on ubuntu-24.04, where Playwright can install Chromium
